contentText:
Sam Altman / @sama :

Sam Altman says OpenAI reached an agreement with the DOD to deploy its models in DOD's classified network and asks DOD to extend those terms to all AI companies   —  Tonight, we reached an agreement with the Department of War to deploy our models in their classified network.
